# Navera Marketing

> Navera Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Sonipat, Haryana, India. Tagline: "A New Era of Brand Growth". Services: social media management (Instagram, Facebook), reels and video production with on-location shoots, graphic design and branding, website development (basic, catalogue and e-commerce), paid advertising on Meta and Google, and SEO with Google Business Profile support.

- All prices are negotiable.
- Monthly plans (service fee, GST extra if applicable, ad spend separate): Essential Rs 9,999/month (10 reels, 10 stories, 2 shoots); Business Growth Rs 19,999/month (16 reels, 16 stories, 8 graphics, 4 shoots, Google Business Profile support); Premium Growth Rs 24,999/month (reels as required, 20 stories, 12 graphics, basic SEO, campaign coordination).
- Websites (one-time): Basic Rs 6,999; Catalogue Rs 14,999 (hosting included); E-commerce Rs 29,999 (hosting + domain included).

- Location: Sonipat, Haryana, India. Serves Sonipat city and Sonipat district (Kundli, Murthal, Rai, Ganaur, Gohana, Kharkhoda) and works online with brands across India.
- Contact (WhatsApp and phone): +91 95881 93144, +91 99961 01371, +91 91382 78999
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/navera.marketing/

## Portfolio (websites and web apps built by Navera Marketing)

- [Aggarwal Properties](https://aggarwalpropertiess.com/) (client website; Plots & land, Sonipat): A plot-sales website for a Sonipat land firm with 10+ years and 150+ acres transacted. Every plot from the layout plans is clickable on a live map, showing size, facing, road width and whether it is available, on resale or sold.
- [Rohtak Property Point](https://rohtakpropertypoint.com/) (client website; Property dealer, Rohtak): A property dealer's Instagram posters, turned into a searchable website. Each poster became a property card with its price, size and area, so buyers can filter plots, floors, kothis and shops instead of scrolling a feed.
- [Chaudhary Nutrition](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/chaudhary-nutrition/) (client website; Nutrition & herbal products, Mohali): A premium redesign of nutritionist Annu Chaudhary's Shopify store. The full catalogue sits in a calm, editorial layout with a Wellness Finder quiz, retouched product photos and checkout that goes straight to the real Shopify cart.
- [Shubh Awas Properties](https://shubhawasproperties.com/) (client website; Plots, floors & townships, Rohtak): A 21-page website for Jagvender Siwach's firm: residential plots, independent floors and township homes in Rohtak, with project pages for Forteasia, Florence and Omaxe City and guides to the city's main sectors.
- [Anuj Properties](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/anuj-properties/) (client website; Property dealer, Sonipat): A 22-page website for a Parsvnath City property dealer working since 1998. Area guides for Parsvnath City, Omaxe City and Sonipat, Google reviews, and call or WhatsApp on every page.
- [Navya Properties](https://www.navyaproperty.com/) (client website; Agricultural land, Haryana & Rajasthan): Agricultural land, plots and farmhouses across Rohtak, Jhajjar, Hisar and north Rajasthan, presented for serious buyers: every property is walked and title-checked before it is listed.
- [BABA Real Estate & Developers](https://baba-real-estate.in/) (client website; Builders & developers, Sonipat): A brand website for Dinesh Garg's development company: residences, plotted land and mixed-use projects in Sonipat, with a direct line to call or WhatsApp the team.
- [SA Real Estate](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/sa-realestate/) (client website; Buy, sell & rent): A listings website for plots, flats, houses, shops and rentals, built so the owner can update it without code: properties, projects and contact details are edited from a simple online form.
- [Ashish Constructions](https://ashishconstruction.com/) (client website; Construction company, Rohtak & Bahadurgarh): A website for a construction company building houses, shops and commercial buildings in Rohtak and Bahadurgarh, with plot and real-estate help for clients starting from scratch.
- [Vrikshā Saār](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/vriksha-saar/) (client website; Architecture & design studio, Delhi, Sonepat & Rajkot): A portfolio website for an architecture, design and urbanism firm with studios in Delhi, Rajkot and Sonepat: residences, housing, interiors and urban design.
- [Dental Experts](https://sonipatdentalexperts.com/) (client website; Dental clinic, Sonipat): A clinic website for Dr. Amit Malik (BDS, MDS, Micro Endodontist) in Sector 8, Sonipat: root canal, crowns and implants explained simply, with WhatsApp booking open 7 days.
- [Satyanand Ayurveda](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/satyanand-ayurveda/) (client website; Ayurvedic products, Online store): An online Ayurvedic store with categories, a cart, coupon codes and a checkout that sends the full order to the shop on WhatsApp, with Cash on Delivery across India.
- [Gold & Silver Jewellery Store](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/jewellery-store/) (concept demo; Jewellery, Concept store): A maroon-and-gold storefront for a jeweller: bridal sets, bangles, rings and coins with metal and category filters, a purity guide and enquiries that open WhatsApp.
- [Skyline Residency 3D](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/tower-3d-demo/) (concept demo; Apartment projects, Interactive 3D): A real-time 3D sales tool for builders that runs in the browser: orbit the towers, check sunlight at any hour, pick a live unit and see the view from its balcony.
- [Sunrise Enclave 3D Map](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/plot-3d-demo/) (concept demo; Plotted townships, Interactive 3D): A 3D township map for plot sellers: live availability, size, facing, corner and park plots, prices, and a sample home that can be placed on any plot.
- [YoPdfs](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/yopdfs/) (web app; PDF & image tools, Web platform): 25 free PDF and image tools that run entirely in the browser: merge, split, compress, edit and convert to Word, Excel or JPG, with no uploads, no watermark and no sign-up.
- [FaceAttend](https://zeus-shourya.github.io/faceattend/attendance.html) (web app; Staff attendance, Web app): An attendance kiosk that runs in the browser: staff check in and out with the date, time and a GPS-stamped photo for each punch, and the records export to CSV.
